scope: Strict-lineage held-out VACE comparison with human semantic veto
summary: Narrow contact proxies improve, but absolute visual recovery is extremely low and human review rejects the adapter; no remaining window is run.
evidence: The evaluator verifies the validation record, frozen manifest assets, target/control/reference/trajectory hashes, both completed inference metadata files, model file hashes, prompt, seed, Git state, and adapter SHA.
Adapted-minus-zero contact ROI is +0.0006081 and contact motion is +0.0039676; proxy gates pass.
Absolute adapted contact/global similarities are only 0.058981/0.007765, and adapted global similarity is slightly below zero-shot 0.007811.

Human review rejects target flower identity, target background recovery, auditable hand-stem appearance, and visual superiority: both generated rows show a green rounded mass, dark field, and colored band.
lessons: Matched lineage and positive local proxies cannot override extremely low absolute quality or a semantic visual veto.
limitations: Only the first unseen contact window runs under the fail-fast policy.
The result remains synthetic and does not improve the real Pexels replacement.
next_actions: Reject this adapter and require stronger multi-scene or paired real/sim appearance supervision before further generation.
